routeHint: Sidebar -> FINANCE -> Products. Log in as a tenant admin so the Create Product button is visible.
alt: Products list showing an organisation membership fee, a donation product and several local group fee products, with Active and Archived tabs
notes: The default sort is Recent (id desc), which fills the whole frame with chapter fee rows and pushes the organisation membership fee below the fold. .prod-sort-btn toggles to name-asc (toggleSort only alternates id-desc / name-asc), which brings Northwind Annual Membership and the Support Northwind's Mission donation into frame alongside the chapter fees the alt describes. Display totals(slower) is ticked on purpose: without it every REVENUE / PAYMENTS cell reads '-' and the list looks unused. SUBSCRIBERS stays '-' because these are one-time prices, not subscriptions.

routeHint: Products -> open the membership fee product -> Prices & Options tab.
alt: Prices and Options tab listing membership prices with names, amounts, a default badge and valid-from dates
notes: The existing capture shows Name / Value / Stripe columns. The current table is name (with default, archived, One-time, Recurring, Company price tags), Amount, optional Registration fee and Age columns, Valid From / Valid To when version history exists, and description (client/src/views/Product/Show.vue:227-400). Ideally capture a product that has at least one price with a previous version so the Valid From / Valid To columns render.

routeHint: Products -> open the membership fee product -> Stats tab.

notes: Same chart component (client/src/views/Product/FinanceStats.vue).
